japanese-kana.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが くりだす　こおりタイプの　こうげき。 ５ターンの　あいだ　あられを　ふらす。

korean.swsh: 다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는 얼음타입의 공격. 5턴 동안 싸라기눈을 내리게 한다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 極巨化寶可夢 所使出的冰屬性攻擊。 在５回合內會降下冰雹。

french.swsh: Une attaque de type Glace que seuls les Pokémon Dynamax peuvent utiliser. Invoque une tempête de grêle qui dure cinq tours.

german.swsh: Eine Eis-Attacke, die nur Dynamax-Pokémon einsetzen können. Lässt fünf Runden lang einen Hagelsturm toben.

spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Hielo ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea una tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos.

italian.swsh: Un attacco di tipo Ghiaccio che può essere eseguito dai Pokémon dynamaxizzati. Causa una grandinata che dura per cinque turni.

english.swsh: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

japanese.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが 繰りだす　こおりタイプの　攻撃。 ５ターンの　間　あられを　降らす。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 极巨化宝可梦 才能使出的冰属性攻击。 在５回合内会降下冰雹。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Hielo ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea una tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos.

effect.full: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy.  If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.
effect.shortEffect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
